author: Abbie Cornall
title: Hiring Colorist and Procreate Illustrator
content: A VERY EXCITING day today! It's RECRUITMENT DAY! I am looking to HIRE two positions - please message me in the DMs if you are interested! Please tag someone you know may fit the brief for these positions! I am looking for 2 freelancers.... the work will just be a few hours at first but will definitely grow more and more over time... 1) A COLORIST ... 2) A PROCREATE ILLUSTRATOR. I require someone creative who is able to use procreate and who is able to HAND FINISH my coloring page designs for me. ... You will also be required to send me your proposed fee for this. I require a proposed fee per video and per 5 pages of hand finished illustrations. Contact: DM on Facebook.
